column3: Near-exact parallel: عند ربك, لا يستكبرون, يسبحون; extends to الليل والنهار and لا يسأمون.
Adds كثرة الذكر as the practice immediately before the focus passage.
Pairs عبادة with refusing الاستنكاف والاستكبار, including الملائكة المقربون.
Near-exact parallel: عنده, لا يستكبرون, عن عبادته; adds لا يستحسرون.
Begins the local 7:189-206 movement; no direct focus pattern yet.
Direct imperative pair: اسجدوا لله and اعبدوا.
Combines سجدا, سبحوا بحمد ربهم, and وهم لا يستكبرون.
Local contrary context: invoked associates cannot give نصر.
Direct sequence: اسجد and اقترب; a positive proximity pattern.
Directly opposes الاستكبار عن عبادتي to دعاء; V12-positive support.
Immediate predecessor: ذكر ربك with تضرعا وخيفة and daily recurrence.
Shares عند الله only; the focus pattern is otherwise absent.
Shows الاستكبار as response to لا إله إلا الله.
Completes 33:41 with repeated تسبيح at day-boundaries.
Joins سبح بحمد ربك to being among الساجدين.
No direct عبادته, تسبيح, or سجود connection.
Local contrary setting of شرك before the focus conclusion.
Adds سبحان الله alongside الإشراك and المتكبر.
Presents not prostrating when القرآن is recited as a contrary response.
Local continuation: calling to الهدى yields no اتباع.
Explicit exclusive عبادة, though it repeats a broad theme already established.
Contrary routing of سجود to الشمس instead of الله.
Extends the 33:41-42 remembrance sequence through الملائكة and رحمة.
V12 contrast boundary only; صغير وكبير do not supply the focus pattern.
Links not being يستكبرون with a distinct social relation; secondary to core parallels.
Local creation contrast for the associates discussed through 7:198.
Contains exclusive worship but adds no close focus wording or posture.
Night recitation is paired with وهم يسجدون.
Local decisive contrast: those invoked are عباد أمثالكم and do not answer.
Links another إله with حسابه عند ربه; retain the V12 contrast as a boundary.
Shares عند ربك, but its reward-and-return setting is remote from the focus act.
Pairs يذكر and يسبح with الغدو والآصال, extending the adjacent daily rhythm.
Exclusive worship is present, but the relocation frame is secondary.
Universal يسبح plus الحمد broadens the focus tasbih element.
Local test of the associates' limbs and senses intensifies the preceding contrast.
V12 contrast boundary; the focus posture and worship sequence are absent.
كبر عند الله concerns comparative gravity, not the focus's الاستكبار pattern.
Local affirmation of Allah as ولي and protector of الصالحين.
Secde refusal and استكبار establish the Iblis counter-pattern, but later cards sharpen it.
Explicitly commands worship of الرب; geographic frame is secondary.
Extends tasbih to الليل and أدبار السجود.
Only names worshippers and what they worship; no posture or anti-pride addition.
Contrasts claimed شفعاء عند الله with سبحان and rejection of شرك.
Local repetition: invoked associates cannot give nusr to anyone.
Shares العلم عند الله but no direct worship or prostration pattern.
Night standing and divine knowledge are relevant atmosphere, not a close focus link.
Local perception contrast after the failed call to guidance.
Uses تستكبرون and هوان, but the death-scene route is indirect.
Inheritance ruling has no material focus connection.
Adds ذكر الله and إقامة الصلاة amid ordinary commerce.
V12 contrast boundary; shared سبحان does not make a positive route here.
Inheritance allocation has no material focus connection.
Immediate ethical instruction helps frame the closing 7:199-206 sequence.
Connects استكبار with denial of return to Allah.
Fear of the Lord is compatible but does not add focus wording or action.
Immediate turn to Allah for refuge prepares the closing responsive posture.
Universal creation-for-worship broadens عبادة, though it is general.
غفلة and ربك are only a remote contextual connection.
Obedient jinn serve بإذن ربه, but no close focus lexicon occurs.
The sabh form is not a secure tasbih route; V12 gives only mixed support.
Describes command-bound heavenly agents, parallel to the focus's obedient near ones.
Immediate تذكر followed by clear sight continues the closing response sequence.
كبرى contrasts rhetorically with pride, but the link is indirect.
Combines يسجد, الملائكة, and وهم لا يستكبرون in a broad parallel.
Immediate contrary continuation, but it lacks the focus acts themselves.
Shows a social voice of الاستكبار rejecting belief.
Adds a measured response to آيات ربهم, rather than blind falling.
Makes عبادة continuous to اليقين; extends the focus's service dimension.
Links earthly استكبار with inability to outrun the final return.
Calling from behind rooms has no material focus connection.
Immediate dependence on revelation from ربي, followed by بصائر and هدى.
عند الله names source of outcome, but worship and posture are absent.
Pairs night-long سجدا with قياما.
The constricted-chest scene only prepares the later tasbih-and-sujud reply.
سبحانه corrects attributive شرك; secondary tasbih evidence.
عند ربك occurs in a punishment designation, not the focus relation.
Pairs tasbih bi-hamd with evening and morning recurrence.
Explicit worship and taqwa support the service element, though broadly.
Following revelation and turning from mushrikun is adjacent in theme, not exact.
Monotheism and trust are secondary; no direct focus act appears.
عباده and divine knowledge are too general for added explanatory value.
Allah's defense of believers is supportive context, not a focus-pattern parallel.
Allah with المتقين is a broad relational parallel only.
Explicit refusal of commanded سجود supplies a clear contrary response.
Combines long-night سجود and تسبيح; redundant but direct.
Agricultural instruction has no material focus connection.
Collective self-description as المسبحون supports the tasbih dimension.
Stages المستكبرون before ربهم; secondary return-and-pride parallel.
The named spring has no material focus connection.
Contrasts ritual at the House, but only a remote عند/act connection.
Explicitly redirects سجود from sun and moon to Allah in the frame of عبادة.
Tasbih bi-hamd at rising extends recurrent praise, but lacks sujud or pride.
رب and الرحمن frame authority, without a close focus action.
Exclusive worship plus gratitude reinforces the عبادته dimension.
Reward for good works has no material focus connection.
المتكبرين receive an inverted final dwelling; a secondary anti-pride consequence.
Generic rejection of messengers has no close focus wording.
Shared رب and direct اعبدوه make a broad worship parallel.
Worship command leads into dispute, but adds little after earlier exclusive-worship cards.
Names Iblis's absence from الساجدين, a direct counter-pattern for the focus ending.
ذكر connects to the immediate pre-focus practice, without the focus posture.
Combines عبادة, ركوع, and سجود in a direct embodied-worship parallel.
Adds continuous ذكر across bodily states; secondary to 7:205-206.
Extends ذكر الله across standing, sitting, and lying after formal prayer.
Includes سجود within a guarded communal prayer setting.
Surah-internal Iblis frame: the command للسجود and his noncompliance.
Directly asks what prevented Iblis from السجود; central contrary background.
Links Iblis's exclusion with the prohibition on تكبر in that setting.
Immediate predecessor: hearing and attending to القرآن before 7:205-206.
Pairs التائبون and العابدون with الراكعون الساجدون.
A distinct سجود scene; useful boundary evidence for posture without the focus pattern.
Combines يسبح الرعد بحمده with الملائكة from خيفته.
Broad prostration parallel: the heavens, earth, and shadows يسجدون لله.
The الملائكة all perform سجود, immediately before the Iblis exception.
States Iblis's refusal to be مع الساجدين.
Extends universal سجود to created things and their ظلال.
Adds خوف ربهم من فوقهم and obedience to command after 16:49.
Universal تسبيح includes seven heavens, earth, and all within them.
Another Iblis refusal of the command اسجدوا لآدم.
Response to recitation includes falling سجدا and increased خشوع.
Names Iblis's refusal of the command to prostrate and his deviation from it.
When the آيات are recited, the prophets fall سجدا and بكيا.
Prayer is explicitly ordered for ذكر; it supports the pre-focus sequence.
A response to the آية is falling سجدا, with a distinct conversion setting.
Reprises the command of سجود and Iblis's refusal.
Universal prostration includes celestial bodies, humans, and creatures; some remain contrary.
The House is prepared for those who circle, stand, bow, and prostrate.
Direct imperative cluster: اركعوا واسجدوا واعبدوا ربكم.
All in the heavens and earth, including birds, are known in their صلاة and تسبيح.
Combines trust with سبح بحمده; contributes the praise dimension.
Direct day-boundary tasbih: حين تمسون and حين تصبحون.
Pairs الحمد with العشي and حين تظهرون, completing 30:17.
Night bodily withdrawal and دعاء ربهم extend the nocturnal worship setting.
ذكر الله كثيرا directly reinforces 33:41 and the 7:205 remembrance pattern.
A named instance of خر راكعا and أناب; a secondary posture parallel.
The angels all perform سجود in the Iblis counter-pattern.
Explicit exception: Iblis استكبر and became among the disbelievers.
Directly questions Iblis about refusal of سجود and whether he استكبر.
Iblis voices an elevation claim immediately after his refusal of سجود.
Night قانت posture joins ساجدا and قائما with fear and hope.
Angels around the Throne يسبحون بحمد ربهم.
The angels يسبحون بحمد ربهم and seek forgiveness.
The worshippers are ركعا سجدا, seeking divine فضل and رضوان.
Commands تسبيح بحمد الرب before sunrise and sunset, preceding 50:40.
Night tasbih and at إدبار النجوم extend the adjacent 52:48 practice.
Direct imperative: سبح باسم ربك العظيم.
Closes with سبح باسم ربك العظيم; a secondary recurrence.
Universal يسبح لله broadens the focus tasbih element.
Universal يسبح لله in the opening of the surah; secondary recurrence.
Closes the divine-name sequence with يسبح له ما في السماوات والأرض.
Universal yusabbihu formula adds a parallel communal-cosmic frame.
Universal tasbih includes الملك القدوس العزيز الحكيم.
After prayer, the command is to seek Allah's bounty and remember Him كثيرا.
Warns that wealth and children not distract from ذكر الله.
Angels do not disobey Allah and do what they are commanded; secondary obedience parallel.
Direct imperative: سبح باسم ربك العظيم.
Remembering the name of the Lord and devoted turning support the pre-focus orientation.
ذكر اسم الرب بكرة وأصيلا closely parallels 7:205's daily markers.
Direct imperative: سبح اسم ربك الأعلى.
ذكر اسم ربه followed by صلاة joins remembrance to embodied worship.
Combines تسبيح بحمد الرب with استغفار at a concluding transition.
